name: plejecenter-kort
description: Interactive map of plejecentre (care homes) across Denmark, on OpenStreetMap data.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && vite build --config vite.admin.config.ts
scripts.test: node tests/regions.test.mjs && node tests/api.test.mjs && npm run test:migration && node tests/theme-sync.test.mjs
scripts.test:migration: node tests/db-skip-schema.test.mjs && node tests/db-request.test.mjs && node tests/cloudflare-adapter.test.mjs
